event.goblin.name: Lost Treasure Goblin
event.goblin.prompt: A treasure goblin ran into the greenhouse! Tap him 5 times before he gets away!
event.goblin.hint: Sometimes you can hear tiny footsteps and a jingle-jangling sound in the greenhouse...
event.goblin.story: A little goblin who carries a cloth bag bigger than himself and searches everywhere for treasure. After being caught by Master, he grumbles "Oh well, whatever for today" and dumps a huge handful of seeds and ingredients out of his bag before running off without looking back.
event.goblin.lumia: I think his bag has the hair tie I lost last time...
event.goblin.summary: A little goblin with a big cloth bag searching for treasure.
event.goblin.need: Have a plant growing in the greenhouse
event.dew.name: Greenhouse Stardust Dew
event.dew.prompt: Stardust dew has formed on the pots! Tap all 3 dew drops down!
event.dew.hint: Early in the morning, the leaves in the greenhouse sometimes sparkle...
event.dew.story: Stray stardust scraps dissolve in the morning dew, turning into glowing dew drops. Collect them and water the plants, and they'll grow tall and strong as if by magic.
event.dew.lumia: The dew is cool and sweet... Ah, no drinking it!
event.dew.summary: Stardust scraps dissolved in dew, forming glowing dew drops.
event.dew.need: At least 2 pots with growing plants
event.dew.reward: {yieldSec}s worth of yield for that pot
event.raincloud.name: Baby Raincloud
event.raincloud.prompt: A baby raincloud floated in! Drag it onto a pot (or tap it then tap a pot)
event.raincloud.hint: Ever since you bought the raincloud, a tiny cloud seems to follow you around to play...
event.raincloud.story: A little raincloud born from the greenhouse raincloud, still figuring out how to control its rain. Put it on a pot and it will happily shower a gentle drizzle, even getting the neighboring pots wet too.
event.raincloud.lumia: It's following me everywhere! Can I keep it?
event.raincloud.summary: A baby cloud still learning to control its rain.
event.raincloud.reward: Growth ×{growth} for the placed pot and adjacent pots ({buffSec}s)
event.raincloud.dropHint: Place the baby raincloud on a pot with a plant
event.butterfly.name: Glow Butterfly
event.butterfly.prompt: A glow butterfly is fluttering in the greenhouse! Tap it to make it land on a pot!
event.butterfly.hint: Once you have more pots, visitors with glowing wings will start appearing in the greenhouse...
event.butterfly.story: A glow butterfly that only appears in greenhouses where flowers bloom best. When it lands on a pot, it scatters glowing scales, and the plants grow along to the rhythm of its flapping wings.
event.butterfly.lumia: Look, Master! It landed right on my nose!
event.butterfly.summary: A glowing butterfly that only appears in greenhouses with the best-blooming flowers.
event.butterfly.need: At least 4 pots with growing plants
event.butterfly.reward: Each butterfly grants ×{growth} plant growth (+1 stack per pot, {buffSec}s)
event.sneeze.name: Salamander Sneeze
event.sneeze.prompt: Achoo! The salamander sneezed out sparks! Catch the falling sparks!
event.sneeze.hint: The little guy by the stove seems to have a tickly nose...
event.sneeze.story: The salamander under the cauldron choked on some smoke and let out a big sneeze. The sparks it sneezed out are actually pure magic—catch them and toss them back into the stove to make all the cauldrons burn brighter.
event.sneeze.lumia: Is he catching a cold? Should we knit him a little scarf...
event.sneeze.summary: A smoke-choked salamander lets out a big sneeze.
event.sneeze.need: Have a cauldron with a salamander
event.bubble.name: Rainbow Bubble
event.bubble.prompt: A rainbow bubble popped out of the cauldron! Pop it before it floats away!
event.bubble.hint: When brewing goes extra smoothly, huge bubbles sometimes form in the pot...
event.bubble.story: When a potion is brewed to perfection, the excess magic wraps into a giant rainbow bubble. Pop it, and all the potions inside will instantly drop right back into the pot.
event.bubble.lumia: Our shop is reflected inside the bubble! It's so pretty!
event.bubble.summary: A rainbow bubble appearing when a potion is brewed to perfection.
event.bubble.reward: {brewSec}s worth of potions from that cauldron (consumes no ingredients)
event.perfect_heat.name: Perfect Heat
event.perfect_heat.prompt: The heat gauge is up! Tap it when the needle hits the gold zone (3 chances)
event.perfect_heat.hint: After getting twin condensers, strange markings sometimes appear on the pots...
event.perfect_heat.story: Ancient alchemy books say the heat is only perfect for a single split second. Catch that exact moment, and every drop of potion in the condenser turns into two.
event.perfect_heat.lumia: Master is amazing! I always tap too early...
event.perfect_heat.summary: The heat is only perfect for a split second.
event.perfect_heat.reward: Each hit doubles that cauldron's output every round for {secPerHit}s
event.apprentice.name: Elf Apprentice Intern
event.apprentice.prompt: An elf apprentice from the guild is here to intern! Drag him onto a cauldron (or tap him then tap a cauldron)
event.apprentice.hint: After signing with the Overworked Elves' Guild, newbies might come by for training...
event.apprentice.story: A fresh graduate from the guild school, holding a stirring rod taller than themselves. Though very nervous, once assigned to a cauldron they stir super hard, making it work much faster.
event.apprentice.lumia: He's working so hard... I have to do my best too!
event.apprentice.summary: A fresh elf apprentice is here at the shop for training.
event.apprentice.need: Signed the Overworked Elves' Guild contract
event.apprentice.dropHint: Place the elf apprentice onto a cauldron
event.hero.name: Rich Hero's Buying Spree
event.hero.prompt: The rich hero is here on a buying spree! Keep tapping him: "Another crate!"
event.hero.hint: Once the shop's renown spreads, very wealthy customers might visit...
event.hero.story: A hero with endless bounty money after defeating the Demon King. As soon as he walks in, he says, "I'll take the lot!" and carries off a crate with every tap. When he shops happily, he even goes around helping to advertise the shop.
event.hero.lumia: Did—did he just toss his entire wallet at us!?
event.hero.summary: A hero with endless bounty gold drops by to buy everything.
event.hero.reward: Earn {incomePerHit} seconds of income per tap (up to {goal} taps)
At {hypeAt} taps: Market Heat boosted to ×{hype} for ({buffSec}s)
event.merchant.name: Wandering Merchant
event.merchant.prompt: The Wandering Merchant is here with rare goods! Pick one of the three items.
event.merchant.hint: After running the shop for a while, a traveler with a big pack might come by...
event.merchant.story: A wandering merchant who travels everywhere, with a pack containing just about anything. He says our potions helped him so much on his travels, so he always trades with us at a wonderful price.
event.merchant.lumia: There seems to be something moving inside his pack...
event.merchant.summary: A wandering merchant whose pack holds all sorts of things.
event.princess.name: Princess in Disguise
event.princess.prompt: Among the customers in line, one seems a bit different... Find the customer with a crown glowing above her head and tap her!
event.princess.hint: A renowned shop that brews Fairywing Elixir might receive a secret visit from a noble guest...
event.princess.story: Hiding in the queue under a cloak was none other than the kingdom's princess. After Master recognized her, she stuck out her tongue and said, 'You found me!', before ordering the entire season's supply of potions for the castle.
event.princess.lumia: P—Princess!? Did I just give her the wrong change...
event.princess.summary: The cloaked customer in line seems a little unusual.
event.princess.need: Shop Renown Lv 9 or higher, unlock Fairywing Elixir
event.guild_rush.name: Merchant Guild Rush
event.guild_rush.prompt: The Merchant Guild sent an emergency buyback notice! Tap the glowing Buyback Crate.
event.guild_rush.hint: Once you have a Buyback Crate, the Merchant Guild will occasionally send special notices...
event.guild_rush.story: A flu broke out in a distant town, and the guild is rushing to buy up large quantities of potions. During this time, the Buyback Crate purchases items at full price, and Master is really helping everyone out.
event.guild_rush.lumia: I hope everyone feels better soon...
event.guild_rush.summary: An emergency buyback notice from the Merchant Guild.
event.guild_rush.reward: Buyback Crate purchases at full price for ({buffSec}s)
event.dream.name: Lumia's Somniloquy
event.dream.prompt: Lumia is sleep-talking... Pop the 3 drifting dream bubbles!
event.dream.hint: When Lumia is sleeping in the lounge, something seems to drift away...
event.dream.story: Sleeping Lumia murmurs to herself as bubbles float out containing her dreams: in them she's mastered all magic, the shop is packed with customers, and Master pats her head saying, 'Good job.'
event.dream.lumia: D—did I just say something weird!?
event.dream.summary: Sleeping Lumia is drifting dream bubbles.
event.dream.need: Lumia is sleeping in the lounge
event.letter.name: Letter from Afar
event.letter.prompt: An owl flew over carrying a letter! Tap to receive it.
event.letter.hint: As your bond with Lumia deepens, letters from afar will arrive...
event.letter.story: (Story TBD: To be written later to match the background lore)
event.letter.need: Bond Level 2 / 4 / 6 (three letters sent in order)
event.letter.reward: A letter (received letters can be re-read here)
event.fortune.name: Fortune-Teller Granny
event.fortune.hint: When you display a crystal ball or your shop's renown is high enough, a mysterious old woman comes knocking...
event.fortune.story: Leaning on a star-topped staff, the granny is said to never be wrong with her fortunes. The card you flip reveals where today's good luck comes from, and it really comes true.
event.fortune.lumia: Granny said my love fortune is... N-no telling Master!
event.fortune.summary: An old woman with a star-topped staff whose fortunes never miss.
event.fortune.need: Gifted the Astrological Crystal Ball or Shop Renown Lv 8+
event.meteor.name: Meteor Shower
event.meteor.prompt: A meteor shower! Tap the shooting stars to make a wish!
event.meteor.hint: Late at night (19:00–05:00), something outside the window...
event.meteor.story: Suddenly, a meteor shower lights up the night sky. Lumia tugs on Master's sleeve and runs to the window. Every shooting star you catch brings a little more luck to the shop.
event.meteor.lumia: The wish I made is... a secret!
event.meteor.summary: A sudden meteor shower lights up the night sky.
event.meteor.need: Real-world time 19:00–05:00, or display the Wishing Star Lamp in the lounge
event.meteor.reward: {incomePerHit} seconds' worth of income per meteor
Catch all 10: bonus reward of equal value
event.slime.name: Slime Moving Day
event.slime.prompt: A slime is bouncing around the shop! Tap it 3 times!
event.slime.hint: When a certain squishy plushie is displayed in the lounge, it seems to attract friends...
event.slime.story: Mistaking the lounge's slime plushie for a friend, a wild slime bounces all around the shop and spits out a pile of gathered materials as a greeting gift.
event.slime.lumia: Puchu! Puchu! It's talking to the plushie!
event.slime.summary: A wild slime that thought it found a friend.
event.slime.need: Display the Slime Plushie in the lounge
event.kind.count: Rapid Tap (Tap as much as you can)

event.result.princess: The princess ordered potions for the whole season: {gold}
event.result.guild_rush: Buyback Crate buys at full price ({sec}s)
event.result.dream: Lumia had a sweet sleep: Stamina fully restored, Happiness +{happy}
